topic: how does the TCP handshake work
narration: Three tiny packets kill ghosts, sync counters, and make every later byte countable. No handshake, no reliable internet.
description: Same laptop left-mid and server right-mid nodes, now joined by thick solid good=green tube at 45% height representing stable connection. Inside tube small fg=white numbered blocks 1,2,3 flow smoothly left to right in order. At tube entrance a translucent shield arc blocks a grey ghost packet with red outline bouncing off. Counter badges above nodes stay good=green locked. Final bold fg=white text 'No handshake, no reliable internet' centers at 60% height.

beats.action: Thick good=green tube snaps into place between nodes replacing thin wire; locked counters remain green.
Grey ghost packet with red outline flies in from side and bounces off shield arc at tube entrance with impact ripple.
Both green counter badges pulse larger showing 43 and 101 synced.
Three numbered fg=white blocks 1-2-3 flow smoothly in order through green tube laptop to server.
Flow freezes, bold text 'No handshake, no reliable internet' pops center with accent3=yellow underline on handshake.
